classification_policy.ambiguous_multi_topic_route: P3 record has multiple mapped topic regions and is not already review-required.
classification_policy.missing_p3_route: P3 routing sidecar record has no primary topic ID mapped to an active P3 region.
classification_policy.review_needed_route: P3 record has a mapped primary region plus review_required=true, or single-topic review reasons.
classification_policy.safe_p3_route: P3 record has one mapped route and no route review reasons.
